mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have pleasant, partly cloudy conditions at Badger Prairie County Park. If you look toward the northwest near Verona High School at 9:15 PM, you can catch the space station passing overhead for 2 minutes as it travels toward Fitchburg. It is a first quarter moon tonight, and we are looking at an overnight low of 58 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to subscribe to their digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects and programs. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development proposals, including work at the Liberty Business Park and various site plans around the town.
Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report regarding service calls between August 31 and September 14, officers noted that on September 5, they discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
Culver's is currently open, but they will be closing in 52 minutes, so make sure to stop by soon before they shut their doors for a remodel.
